newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish police seize one tonne of cocaine on boat.
newsitem.headline: Spanish police seize one tonne of cocaine on boat.

text.p: Spanish police seized one tonne of cocaine on Sunday and arrested 16 people in what they described as one of the most important drug hauls in recent years.
Customs officers raided a boat 70 sea miles from the northwest coast of Galicia during the night and found an estimated one tonne of cocaine.
Eight people were arrested on board the "Anita", which was carrying the drugs from Barbados. Three were from Spain, four from Senegal and one from Togo.
Police said another eight people were detained on land and more arrests would follow.

"It is one of the largest operations in recent times," said Gonzalo Robles, director of the National Anti-Drug Plan. "It represents the downfall of the biggest drug-smuggling group currently operating in Galicia."
The operation was the outcome of a one-year-long investigation and involved members of the customs, the defence ministry, security forces and Spain's High Court.
